skill.name: frontend-developer
skill.description: Build, test, debug, and optimize frontend applications with practical guidance for components, APIs, state, tooling, accessibility, and responsive design.
skill.summary: Implement complete frontend workflows from project setup through testing and performance optimization.
skill.author: zl2023github

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, TypeScript template literals, relative imports, and normal frontend configuration examples. Two command blocks execute remote npm tooling, and the authentication templates persist bearer tokens in browser storage. Review package sources and replace persistent token storage before publication.

remediation.issue: Scaffolding and dependency examples run remote npm packages, including unpinned latest versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed package versions, verify package names and lockfiles, and require user confirmation before running npm or npx commands.

remediation.issue: Authentication examples store bearer tokens in localStorage and persisted Zustand state.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer short-lived memory storage or secure HttpOnly cookies, and prevent authentication state from entering production developer tools.

medium_findings.title: Ruby/shell backtick execution
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fenced block runs npm and npx scaffolding commands, including latest package versions. These commands download and execute remote package code.

medium_findings.title: Ruby/shell backtick execution
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fenced block instructs npm and npx dependency installation and initialization. Package lifecycle scripts can execute code from remote dependencies.

medium_findings.title: Persistent Bearer Token Exposure
medium_findings.description: The templates read a bearer token from localStorage and persist the authentication token in Zustand state. An XSS flaw or browser extension could steal it.
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples explicitly retrieve and persist the authentication token in browser storage, creating a clear credential-exposure pattern.

content.value_statement: Frontend work often spans setup, UI implementation, API integration, testing, and performance tuning. This skill provides a structured workflow with practical templates and verification steps.
actual_capabilities: Initializes projects with Vite, Next.js, Nuxt, or Create React App.
Builds typed, responsive, accessible UI components with loading, empty, and error states.
Integrates REST or GraphQL APIs with client configuration, caching, and error handling.
Configures TypeScript, linting, formatting, build tools, package managers, and monorepos.
Writes unit, component, and end-to-end tests with common frontend testing tools.
Diagnoses bugs and performance issues using browser tools, Lighthouse, and bundle analysis.
limitations: The examples require adaptation to the repository framework, conventions, and dependency versions.
The skill does not supply backend services, API credentials, designs, or production infrastructure.
Commands can install remote packages and should run only after dependency review and user approval.
Authentication templates need stronger token storage before production use.

use_cases.title: Scaffold a New Application
use_cases.description: Create a typed frontend project with routing, state, styling, quality tools, and a verified development build.

use_cases.title: Convert Designs into Components
use_cases.description: Implement reusable, responsive, accessible components from design requirements and validate their interaction states.

use_cases.title: Modernize an Existing Frontend
use_cases.description: Refactor data flow, add tests, resolve defects, and improve measured performance without replacing the entire application.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Typed Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [framework] component for [feature]. Include typed properties, responsive styles, accessibility, and loading, empty, error, and disabled states.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate an API
prompt_templates.prompt: Connect [page or component] to [API description]. Define request types, response types, caching, loading behavior, error handling, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Frontend Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [bug or performance issue] in this repository. Reproduce it, identify the root cause, implement a focused fix, and verify measurable results.

prompt_templates.title: Deliver a Frontend Modernization
prompt_templates.prompt: Modernize [application area] while preserving behavior. Assess architecture, migrate incrementally, strengthen security and accessibility, add tests, and verify build and performance targets.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive user profile card in React with loading and error states.
output_examples.output: A typed React component, responsive styling, accessible controls, state handling, focused tests, and verification results.

output_examples.input: Connect the users page to a paginated REST endpoint.
output_examples.output: Typed API models, a reusable client method, cached queries, pagination controls, failure handling, and component tests.

output_examples.input: Reduce slow initial rendering on the dashboard.
output_examples.output: A measured diagnosis, targeted bundle and rendering changes, regression tests, and before-and-after performance metrics.

best_practices: Provide repository context, framework versions, browser targets, and acceptance criteria before implementation.
Review proposed dependencies and commands before allowing package installation or external network access.
Require builds, tests, accessibility checks, and measured performance evidence before accepting changes.
anti_patterns: Do not request a complete application without defining users, workflows, data contracts, and visual requirements.
Do not accept generated code that ignores existing architecture, conventions, or dependency constraints.
Do not place long-lived authentication tokens in browser persistence without a documented threat model.

faq.question: Which frontend frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, and Nuxt patterns, but implementations must follow the selected repository.

faq.question: Can it create a project from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can scaffold a project, configure tooling, add dependencies, create structure, and verify the development build.

faq.question: Does it write tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers unit, component, and end-to-end tests using Vitest, Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress.

faq.question: Can it connect frontend code to an API?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the API contract, authentication model, error rules, and environment details for accurate integration.

faq.question: Will it run package installation commands automatically?
faq.answer: Commands require review because npm and npx can download packages and execute lifecycle scripts.

faq.question: Is the authentication template production ready?
faq.answer: No. Replace persistent browser token storage with a reviewed authentication design before production deployment.
